current_role: Attorney General of Texas (since 2015); lost the November 2026 U.S. Senate race
summary: Ken Paxton has been Texas attorney general since 2015. With Trump's endorsement he ousted Sen. John Cornyn in the May 2026 Republican runoff, 64% to 36%, but lost the November 2026 general election to Democrat James Talarico, the first Democratic statewide win in Texas in more than 30 years. Ted Cruz was one of his main backers.
